provisioning_notes: DESIGN ONLY: no native recipe, spell, item, property, socket, event hook, cast route or ID is admitted; every candidate remains blocked until a compatible native or explicitly qualified custom route is observed.

Base equipment comes first. A finish requires a buyer-supplied or commissioned role-appropriate weapon or armor with its own damage, armor and stats; an enchant alone does not make a white item a good Northrend kit.
Each finish replaces the compatible native enchant or socket channel. Enchantments and support finishes do not all stack; later maker skill does not mutate old gear.
Chest, legs, head and shoulders are qualified slot routes only. Their catalogue presence does not assert that a native cast or property route exists.

Field and masterwork inputs are common-need friendly: lawful stock and disenchanting of authorized spare items may supply dust or shards. Useful equipped gear is never destroyed, and common materials are not raid-gated.

City enchanters make an independent credited contribution at a qualified station. Legendary work additionally records the core owner, base maker, finisher and collaborators as separate child commissions; sharing a project is not free skill.

For every proc or aura, the exact equipped item is the source. Hostile or eligible ally targets, native group/range rules, removal on unequip/logout/death/removal/group or range change, cooldown, nonmultiplication of identical aura families and no recursive proc chain must be admitted and observed before release.

Personal earned boss legacies remain separate from maker rewards and these proposed finishes. No universal strong-player buff, friendly self-trigger, ambient damage charge or unlimited proc chain is implied.

The five legendary stages are meaningful production work: preparation, forging or weaving, tempering, signature finishing, and inspection and attunement. Early records are work or subcomponents until every stage qualifies for exact final-item materialization.
